title: Tshivenda Study UI full-scope draft candidates
head: 25f6baaefc56e82a4fae5f679a43aa5f605d66f0
scope: All 103 Tshivenda rows in the supplied current-gap packet; source bindings and display conditions retained. Technical UI terms are kept in English where no defensible local equivalent is available. Claims that may mislead for silent decks are held.
globalCaveat: These are machine drafts for independent source/meaning review. The neighboring Tshivenda strings provided terminology anchors only; they do not establish fluent idiom. No Sesotho or Xitsonga wording was used as Tshivenda authority. In particular, Kambela was not used for Tshivenda.
